takeaways: Hundreds of cryptic measure names slow analysts down, invite duplicate calculations and erode trust in reports.
Saving models as PBIP projects with TMDL exposes measures and formatting as plain text, so bulk renames and find-and-replace take minutes instead of days.
Storing the text files in Git adds branching, diffs, rollback and an audit trail, which makes bulk refactoring safe and team collaboration manageable.
hook: Staring at a Power BI model with five hundred cryptically named measures? This episode is for Power BI developers and BI teams who need to clean up and collaborate on large models. Learn how PBIP, TMDL and Git turn painful click-by-click renaming into fast, reversible bulk edits.
